title: Senior Software Engineer - .NET with Azure
description:
*EPAM is a leading global provider of digital platform engineering and development services. We are committed to having a positive impact on our customers, our employees, and our communities. We embrace a dynamic and inclusive culture. Here you will collaborate with multi\-national teams, contribute to a myriad of innovative projects that deliver the most creative and cutting\-edge solutions, and have an opportunity to continuously learn and grow. No matter where you are located, you will join a dedicated, creative, and diverse community that will help you discover your fullest potential.*


We are seeking a highly skilled **Senior Software Engineer with strong expertise in .NET and Azure** to join our growing team. In this role, you will design, develop, and maintain robust, scalable solutions while leveraging your deep knowledge of Microsoft technologies and cloud services to drive innovation and deliver high\-quality software.

**Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, and maintain scalable applications using C\# and .NET
* Build and deploy serverless solutions leveraging Azure Functions
* Develop and optimize database objects, including stored procedures, functions, and triggers using T\-SQL
* Perform query optimization and analyze execution plans to enhance database performance
* Manage and configure Microsoft SQL Server environments, including SQL Server Agent jobs and Transactional Replication
* Implement backup and recovery strategies to ensure data integrity and availability
* Automate operational tasks and deployments using PowerShell scripting
* Establish and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to define, design, and ship new features
* Provide technical mentorship and conduct code reviews to uphold engineering best practices

**Requirements**

* 6\+ years of professional software development experience
* Proficiency in C\# and .NET fundamentals
* Expertise in Azure Functions and Azure SQL Managed Instance
* Strong background in Microsoft SQL Server, including T\-SQL (Stored Procedures, Functions, Triggers)
* Skills in query optimization and execution plan analysis
* Knowledge of Transactional Replication, Backup \& Recovery, and SQL Server Agent
* Competency in PowerShell scripting for automation
* Familiarity with CI/CD practices and GitHub Actions
* Proficiency in English at an Upper\-Intermediate level (B2\) or higher

**Nice to have**

* Exposure to Azure services such as AKS
* Understanding of Azure Networking

**We offer**

* Opportunity to work on technical challenges that may impact across geographies
* Vast opportunities for self\-development: online university, knowledge sharing opportunities globally, learning opportunities through external certifications
* Opportunity to share your ideas on international platforms
* Sponsored Tech Talks \& Hackathons
* Unlimited access to LinkedIn learning solutions
* Possibility to relocate to any EPAM office for short and long\-term projects
* Focused individual development
* Benefit package:
	+ Health benefits
	+ Retirement benefits
	+ Paid time off
	+ Flexible benefits
* Forums to explore beyond work passion (CSR, photography, painting, sports, etc.)

title: Solution Architect-.Net, Blazor, Azure
description:
We are looking for an experienced **Solution Architect** to join a large\-scale platform modernization program. The role involves migrating legacy **.NET Framework/WPF applications** to **modern .NET, Blazor Server, Clean Architecture, DDD, and Azure**.

The ideal candidate should have strong architecture experience and be capable of owning technical decisions across multiple services, domains, and delivery phases.

Key Responsibilities

* Own **end\-to\-end solution architecture** across multiple services and business domains.
* Define **service boundaries, bounded contexts, integration patterns, and architecture standards**.
* Drive modernization from **.NET Framework/WPF to modern .NET and Blazor Server**.
* Define Blazor component, BFF, API, and application\-layer architecture.
* Design **database/schema migration and EF Core coexistence strategies**.
* Create practical architecture artefacts including **system context, API flows, security sequences, and deployment designs**.
* Establish **coding, security, authorization, and PR standards** across services.
* Work closely with **developers, BAs, DevOps, and other stakeholders** to resolve design challenges.
* Contribute to architecture planning for future phases, integrations, and domain expansion.
* Use **Cursor AI** as part of the development and architecture workflow.

Required Skills

* **8\+ years** of software delivery experience with **5\+ years as a Solution/Software Architect**.
* Strong experience with **.NET Framework 4\.x and modern .NET 8\+**.
* Proven experience in **legacy modernization/migration programs**.
* Strong hands\-on experience with **Clean Architecture and DDD**.
* Strong experience with **Blazor Server**.
* Hands\-on experience with **Ocelot or YARP API Gateway**.
* Strong **EF Core 8\+** experience, including migrations and performance optimization.
* Strong Azure experience with **Azure DevOps, ACR, AKS, Key Vault, and Entra ID**.
* Strong knowledge of **JWT, OAuth 2\.0, RBAC, and policy\-based authorization**.
* Hands\-on experience using **Cursor AI** or similar AI\-assisted development tools.

Preferred Skills

* Experience migrating **WPF/WinForms to Blazor** at scale.
* Insurance, financial services, or other regulated\-domain experience.
* Event\-driven architecture and messaging.
* Azure Solutions Architect Expert certification.
* Experience working on long\-term, multi\-phase modernization programs.

Pay: ₹100,000\.00 \- ₹4,000,000\.00 per year

Work Location: In person

title: Sr. Solutions Architect, AWS Industries India - HCLS
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small\- and mid\-market accounts to enterprise\-level customers including public sector.
  

  

As an Amazon Web Services (AWS) Solutions Architect in AWS Industries HCLS segment, you are responsible for partnering with our most valuable customers to design cloud and AI architectures utilizing AWS services. You have technical depth, business aptitude, and the ability to lead in\-depth technology discussions, articulating the business value of the AWS platform and services. Effective communication and interpersonal skills are required for engaging and influence Enterprise Architects, Technical Architects, Cloud Architects, Directors, VP’s and CXOs.  

  

You will partner some of the worlds largest companies, to craft highly scalable, flexible and resilient cloud and AI architectures that address customer business problems and accelerate the adoption of AWS services. In collaboration with account managers, you will assist in driving growth across a small set of global customers in your defined country. As a trusted customer advocate, the solutions architect will help organizations understand best practices around advanced cloud\-based solutions, and how to migrate existing workloads to the cloud. You will have the opportunity to help shape and execute a strategy to build mind\-share and broad use of AWS within enterprise customers. The ability to connect technology with measurable business value is critical to a solutions architect. You should also have a demonstrated ability to think strategically about business, products, and technical challenges.  

  

Here are some other qualities we are looking for:  

Enjoy working with large, global customers as an active contributor to a diverse team. You will have a passion for educating, training, designing, and building cloud solutions for a diverse and challenging set of enterprise customers.  

Have a strong understanding of large scale computing solutions. You will enjoy keeping your existing technical skills honed and developing new ones, so you can make strong contributions to deep architecture discussions. You will regularly take part in deep\-dive education and design exercises to create world\-class solutions built on AWS.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Ensure success in building and migrating applications, software and services on the AWS platform
* Architect AI\-ML and Generative AI solutions on AWS
* In partnership with the account management team, formulate and execute a strategy
* Educate customers of all sizes on the value proposition of AWS, and participate in deep architectural discussions to ensure solutions are designed for successful deployment in the cloud
* Conduct one\-to\-few and one\-to\-many training sessions to transfer knowledge to customers considering or already using AWS
* Capture and share best\-practice knowledge amongst the AWS solutions architect community
* Author or otherwise contribute to AWS customer\-facing publications such as whitepapers
* Build deep relationships with senior technical individuals within customers to enable them to be cloud advocates
* Act as a technical liaison between customers, service engineering teams and support

  

A day in the life  

* Review customer requirements and technical challenges, focusing on opportunities to implement complex solutions architectures that can transform business outcomes also leveraging AI capabilities
* Develop proof\-of\-concepts that demonstrate how cloud solutions can transform business processes
* Influence service team leadership and product marketing on the future needs for customers, prioritizing roadmap features and GTM messaging
* Dedicate time to continuous learning about the latest advancements in AWS service capabilities
* Participate in knowledge sharing activities with colleagues, creating field enablement materials to help tech community understand how to integrate cloud solutions into customer architectures

  

About the team  

The AWS Industries team is committed to helping industry customers enable their digital transformation journeys. Our primary goal is to meet customers in their cloud and AI journey and work backwards from their industry\-specific needs to transform their businesses and industries. Our team focuses on business outcomes and industry use cases on behalf of our customers, whether that is how we build products and solutions, how we sell, how we deliver, or how we partner.  

  

The HCLS Solutions Architecture team is dedicated to accelerating AWS cloud adoption across strategic Healthcare and Life Sciences accounts. Our mission is to drive tangible business value through focused execution on strategic projects, while enabling scale by up\-skilling broader field teams. We work at the intersection of technology and industry\-specific transformation, partnering closely with account teams, technology specialists, and industry specialist teams to deliver comprehensive solutions.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 8\+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data \& analytics) experience
* 3\+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
* 10\+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience
* Bachelor's degree or above in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent, or Bachelor's degree
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent, or experience in a professional field

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience migrating or transforming legacy customer solutions to the cloud

title: Cloud Architect
description:
Designation \- Cloud Architect

Location: Bengaluru

**About the Role:** We are looking for a Cloud Architect to lead our Cloud Infrastructure team and own the reliability, scalability, security, and cost optimization of our CDP platform across all client environments. You will be a hands\-on technical leader who sets the architectural direction for cloud infrastructure while managing a small, high\-impact team.

This is a leadership hire — you will report directly to the VP Engineering and be accountable for infrastructure that processes billions of customer events monthly for enterprise clients in regulated industries.

What You Will Do

* Define and own the cloud architecture strategy across AWS, GCP and Azure
* Manage and mentor a team of 2 DevOps engineers, growing the team as needed
* Design and maintain infrastructure\-as\-code (Terraform, CloudFormation) for all environments — development, staging, production, and client\-specific
* Implement and manage CI/CD pipelines using GitLab CI/CD serving all engineering teams
* Own the monitoring and observability stack — alerting, dashboards, incident response, and SLAs
* Manage Kubernetes and container orchestration across all environments
* Drive cloud cost optimization — target 20%\+ annual reduction through RI planning, spot instances, right\-sizing, and architectural improvements
* Ensure security compliance — access management, encryption, audit trails for regulated industries
* Design and maintain multi\-tenant infrastructure for client isolation
* Own disaster recovery, backup strategies, and business continuity planning
* Own and operate Kafka clusters — broker management, topic configuration, consumer group monitoring, performance tuning, and scaling
* Manage MongoDB infrastructure — replica sets, sharding, backup, performance optimization, and capacity planning
* Manage storage infrastructure across both clouds — object storage, block storage, database storage, lifecycle policies, and cost optimization
* Collaborate with data platform teams on analytical database infrastructure (Snowflake, BigQuery) and integration with streaming pipelines
* Support client\-facing engineers with environment provisioning, scaling, and performance troubleshooting
* Provision compute resources for data science model training

**What You Bring (Must\-Have)** 

* 10\+ years in cloud infrastructure / DevOps, with 3\+ years in an architect or lead role
* Deep expertise in AWS (EC2, EKS, RDS, S3, Lambda, CloudWatch, IAM, VPC) and GCP (GCE, GKE, Cloud Storage, BigQuery, IAM)
* Deep expertise in Kafka — cluster deployment, broker tuning, partition management, consumer lag monitoring, scaling strategies, and production troubleshooting
* Deep expertise in MongoDB — replica set architecture, sharding, backup/restore, performance profiling, index optimization, and capacity planning
* Deep expertise in Kubernetes — cluster lifecycle management, pod scheduling, resource limits, networking (Ingress, Service Mesh), RBAC, and troubleshooting production issues
* Strong experience with storage architecture — object storage (S3, GCS), block storage (EBS, Persistent Disks), database storage optimization, lifecycle management, and cross\-cloud storage strategies
* Strong experience with CI/CD using GitLab — pipeline design, multi\-environment deployments, artifact management, GitLab Runner management, and integration with Kubernetes
* Infrastructure\-as\-code (Terraform preferred) — multi\-cloud provisioning, state management, modular design Monitoring and observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana, DataDog, or ELK stack)
* Experience with cost optimization at scale — RI planning, spot/preemptible instances, right\-sizing, architectural cost decisions across AWS and GCP
* Security\-first mindset — experience with compliance frameworks relevant to regulated industries
* Experience managing and mentoring a team of 2–5 engineers
* Strong communication skills — ability to work with data engineers, product engineers, and client\-facing teams

Pay: ₹2,500,000\.00 \- ₹3,000,000\.00 per year

Work Location: In person

title: Senior Automation Expert (f/m/d) IT/OT Security Platforms
description:
**Together, we make the difference**  

Siemens IT enables secure, reliable and scalable digital services for Siemens businesses and factories worldwide. Within IT IPS, we develop and operate services that support the transformation of industrial environments towards modern, secure and standardized IT/OT operations.


As an Automation Engineer (f/m/d) for **IT/OT Security Platforms**, you will play a key role in building, automating, and operating the technical foundation of these strategic services. You will work closely with service managers, solution architects, operations teams, and factories worldwide to deliver scalable, automated, and secure solutions that support Siemens' Zero Trust and industrial digitalization strategy. Our OT Zero Trust Platform enables secure IT/OT communication through identity\-based connectivity concepts.

 **What we offer you**

* An attractive remuneration package
* Access to Siemens share plans
* 30 days of paid vacation and a variety of flexible work schedules that allow time off for you and your family
* Flexible training opportunities for both your professional and personal development that you can tailor to your interests


Since each of over 300,000 team members feels that other benefits are particularly important, and we cannot list our entire benefit portfolio here, you can find more information here.


The individual benefits are subject to regulatory, contractual, or corporate conditions.

 **What part will you play?**

* You design, implement, and maintain automation solutions for IT/OT Security Platforms (specifically but not exclusively SINEC Secure Connect, ensuring secure, scalable, and reliable service operations).
* You develop and operate Infrastructure\-as\-Code (IaC) solutions using modern automation frameworks and support the automated deployment of platforms and services across Siemens factory environments.
* You build and maintain CI/CD pipelines, operational tooling, and automation workflows to improve service delivery, reduce manual effort, and increase operational efficiency.
* You integrate platforms, tools, and services through APIs and automation frameworks to enable seamless operational processes and data flows.
* You support the implementation and operation of Zero Trust connectivity solutions and contribute to the automation of policy management, provisioning, and operational workflows.
* You collaborate with factories and project teams to integrate solutions into existing IT and OT environments while considering operational requirements and brownfield infrastructures.
* You support troubleshooting, monitoring, and continuous service improvement activities and help ensure stable operations across global deployments.
* You evaluate and leverage modern technologies such as AI\-driven automation, analytics, and operational intelligence to continuously improve platform operations and deployment processes.
* You actively shape the journey to AI\-native OT security services.

 **What you bring to the table**

* You have a university degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Automation, or a comparable qualification.
* You possess strong expertise in **Infrastructure as Code and Platform Automation**, including Terraform, Open Tofu, Ansible, CI/CD pipelines, scripting, and automated deployment of connectivity and operations platforms (at least 3\+ years of experience).
* Scripting/programming skills with Python/Bash/Go.
* Proven hands\-on experience with Cloud (AWS) and containerized environments and microservices like Docker (at least 2\+ years of experience).
* You have experience with **AI\-driven DevOps, Operations and Automation**, including the use of LLMs, GitHub Copilot, AIOps concepts, workflow automation, and analytics\-driven operational improvements.
* You bring hands\-on experience in **OpenZiti Development** (optional) **and API Integration** (mandatory), including SDKs, REST APIs, policy automation, and custom tooling to integrate Zero Trust networking capabilities into applications and operational workflows. (1\+ years of experience).
* You have a solid understanding of **OT Infrastructure and Industrial Protocols**, including PLCs, HMIs, OPC UA, PROFINET, machine\-to\-machine communication, OT troubleshooting, and the secure integration of solutions into brownfield factory environments. You also understand the emerging role of AI agents in OT environments and the underlying connectivity, security, and operational requirements they introduce.
* You possess knowledge of Cybersecurity, PKI, certificate lifecycle management, Active Directory, Single Sign\-On (at least 1\+ year of experience).
* You are able to bridge IT and OT requirements and collaborate effectively with architects, factory engineers, operations teams, and business stakeholders.
* You are passionate about automation, standardization, and continuous improvement, with a strong focus on reducing manual effort through scalable technical solutions.
* You provide your support during Central European Time Zone (CET).
* Fluent English skills complete your profile. German language skills are beneficial.


You are much more than your qualifications, and we believe in the potential of every single candidate. We look forward to getting to know you!


At Siemens, we believe that feeling valued and included is the foundation for doing great work. title: Security Architect
description:
**Project Role :** Security Architect  

**Project Role Description :** Define the cloud security framework and architecture, ensuring it meets the business requirements and performance goals. Document the implementation of the cloud security controls and transition to cloud security\-managed operations.
  

**Must have skills :** Security Information and Event Management (SIEM)  

**Good to have skills :** NA  

Minimum **12** year(s) of experience is required  

**Educational Qualification :** 15 years full time education  

  

Summary:
  

As a Security Architect, a typical day involves designing and establishing a comprehensive cloud security framework that aligns with organizational objectives and operational standards. This role requires overseeing the development and documentation of security controls tailored for cloud environments, ensuring seamless integration and transition to managed cloud security operations. The position demands continuous evaluation of security architecture to support business needs while maintaining optimal performance and compliance within the cloud infrastructure.  

  

Roles \& Responsibilities:
  

* Expected to be an SME, collaborate and manage the team to perform.
* Responsible for team decisions.
* Engage with multiple teams and contribute on key decisions.
* Expected to provide solutions to problems that apply across multiple teams.
* Lead the development and enforcement of cloud security policies and procedures to safeguard organizational assets.
* Facilitate knowledge sharing and mentorship within the team to enhance overall security expertise and capabilities.
* Coordinate with stakeholders to align security architecture with evolving business strategies and regulatory requirements.


  

Professional \& Technical Skills:
  

* Must To Have Skills: Proficiency in Security Information and Event Management (SIEM).
* Experience in designing and implementing cloud security architectures and frameworks.
* Strong knowledge of security controls, risk management, and compliance standards relevant to cloud environments.
* Ability to analyze security incidents and develop effective mitigation strategies.
* Familiarity with security monitoring, threat detection, and incident response processes.
* Skilled in collaborating across teams to integrate security solutions within complex IT infrastructures.


  

Additional Information:
  

* The candidate should have minimum 7 years of experience in Security Information and Event Management (SIEM).


\- This position is based at our BDC14A \- STPI office.  

* A 15 years full time education is required.
